Thanks Vivek / Emma — looping in a few concrete legal sequencing decisions so expectations are clear: 

1) MSA first-cut: Redwood will provide a redline-ready MSA (standard Redwood enterprise MSA) within 24 hours of kick-off. We will mark non-negotiable, negotiable, and preferred positions in the document.
2) DPA parallel path: DPA comments that concern security controls (encryption, subprocessor list) will be triaged by Security (Rachel). Non-technical DPA clauses (liability caps tied to Order Form value) will follow legal review — but we can provisionally flag desired limits in the MAP.
3) Order Form hold: Procurement should refrain from final signature until DPA is agreed; we can include an "execute upon" clause in the Order Form which references executed DPA to avoid rework.

Potential blockers I see from past deals: cross-border transfer language and indemnity linkage between MSA and Order Form. If HealthMerge needs stronger data residency guarantees, that will add 2–3 business days for architecture sign-off.

I added suggested review windows into the MAP spreadsheet (column "Legal TAT"). I'm available for the Monday call as well.
